# Agent Deploy

> Step-by-step install guides for running AI agents and local models on your own server. No accounts, no live SSH, nothing stored.

## What this site is

Agent Deploy is a free, browser-based tool that builds personalized, copy-and-paste installation guides for self-hosted AI agent stacks. Answer a few questions about your server, pick a stack, and get a tailored install script, a verification checklist, and a troubleshooting guide. Everything is generated client-side in your browser.

## How it works

1. Pick a stack — OpenClaw, Ollama, Open WebUI, n8n, NVIDIA NemoClaw, Hermes, Razer AIKIT, or Atomic Agents.
2. Choose options — models, extras, and server details (IP, OS, user).
3. Copy and run — get a personalized install script you can save to a Gist or CodePen, plus verification and troubleshooting steps.

Guide selections can be shared as permalink URLs (the `/setup` page encodes choices in the query string, e.g. `/setup?stack=ollama`).

- Home and stack catalog: https://ai.mikedemo.dev/

## Install guides

- OpenClaw — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/openclaw — Install OpenClaw and Ollama on your VPS to run local models; your AI environment stays online even when your laptop is off.
- Ollama — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/ollama — Install just Ollama and the models you want, exposed over HTTP from your own apps, with no extra dashboard or agent layer.
- Open WebUI — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/openwebui — Install Ollama plus Open WebUI to chat with your models through a clean web interface running on your own server.
- n8n — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/n8n — Install n8n workflow automation alongside Ollama so your workflows can use local LLMs without sending data to third parties.
- NVIDIA NemoClaw — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/nemoclaw — Deploy NVIDIA NemoClaw on a GPU-equipped VPS to run agent workflows accelerated by NVIDIA inference tools.
- Hermes — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/hermes — Install Hermes models through Ollama and run them locally on your VPS; Hermes models are known for strong instruction following.
- Razer AIKIT — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/razeraikit — Install Razer AIKIT on a compatible VPS or edge device to run optimized local inference pipelines and manage connected devices.
- Atomic Agents — https://ai.mikedemo.dev/guide/atomic-agents — Install the Atomic Agents Python framework alongside Ollama to build agent pipelines from small, testable pieces.
